note: Offset as byte offset, size as byte length, count as in number of elements / stride, index for offset elements by stride. The idea that this is pedantic but help limit confusion. Another suggestion is to prefer 'big-endian' naming that puts the concept or group before the finer grained logistics. e.g. 'source_index', 'target_index' rather than 'index_src' etc. Yet another is to talk about 'index' for 0-based arrays and 'number' for 1-based arrays. e.g. C's indices vs. shell/awk column number.
